title_zh: 询问演讲焦虑支持并请求首次咨询

scenario.label_zh: 咨询公开发言焦虑的支持服务
scenario.goal_zh: 说明演讲时的惊慌感，了解心理支持的初次会面方式并请求预约

context_zh: 学生向大学支持中心询问服务，不在对话中作诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: I feel a wave of panic before class presentations. Is this somewhere I can talk about it?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: Yes. We offer psychological support, and the first meeting is a chance to explain what's happening.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Would I meet a psychologist? I don't want someone to label me after one conversation.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: You can request one. You can also ask how they work before deciding what to discuss.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: That helps. Could you arrange an initial appointment?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I can take your request and send you the available times through the student portal.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Please do. I'll choose a time once I receive them.
